app.name: TouriBook
app.tagline: Book your activities in one click

home.subtitle: Discover and book the best tourist activities.
home.heroSub: Turquoise coves, thousand-year-old medinas, endless dunes — discover and book the country's best experiences.

cancel.title: Free cancellation
cancel.body: Change your mind up to 48 h before departure, at no cost.

guides.title: Local guides
guides.body: Every experience is led by someone who actually lives there.

payment.title: Secure payment
payment.body: Pay online or on site — your data stays protected.

activities.description: Browse the best activities to book near you.

favorites.description: Open your favorite activities again quickly.
favorites.subtitle: The experiences you loved, in one place.
favorites.emptySub: Tap the heart on any activity to keep it here.
favorites.loginSub: Favorites are saved to your account.

bookings.description: View your current bookings and upcoming trips.
